L01.text: Raises ValueError if amount is not a number between zero and max_rate, inclusive.
L01.context: spec is true when amount is accepted (no ValueError is raised).

L02.text: Allow up to max_rate / time_period acquisitions before blocking.
L02.context: n is the number of acquisitions of amount 1 made within one time period; spec is true when all n acquisitions proceed without blocking.

L03.text: True if cost could be deducted from the rate limit without exceeding it.
L03.context: limit is the limit; used is the amount already consumed in the current window; cost is the amount requested; spec is true when the call returns True.

L04.text: The entire number of tokens requested must be available in the bucket to be conforming.
L04.context: requested is the number of tokens requested; available is the number of tokens currently in the bucket; spec is true when the request is conforming.

L05.text: Maximum function invocations allowed within a time period.
L05.context: calls is that maximum; k is the number of invocations made within one period; spec is true when all k invocations are allowed.

L07.text: Returns None when the item can never fit (the weight exceeds the rate limit).
L07.context: weight is the item weight; limit is the rate limit (the maximum weight per interval); spec is true when the item can never fit.

L08.text: limit: Number of requests allowed within interval.
L08.context: limit is that number; n is the number of unit-weight requests made within one interval; spec is true when all n requests are allowed.

L09.text: Acquire an entry if the weighted count of the current and previous windows is less than or equal to the limit.
L09.context: existing is the weighted count already recorded; amount is the amount requested by this call; limit is the limit; the previous window is empty; spec is true when the entry is acquired.

L10.text: capacity (int): Maximum number of tokens that the bucket can hold.
L10.context: capacity is that maximum; n is the number of tokens requested from a freshly created, full bucket; spec is true when that request is conforming.
